summary: The {server} base-path template is a complete base URL with its scheme; base_url is only another source for it and must never be prepended on top.
reason: The generic endpoint-template normalizer stripped the scheme and the client also prepended base_url, so requests went to http://host:8123host:8123/api/... and every call failed.
validated_outcome: server_url_test.go and client_test.go cover scheme preservation, base_url fallback and no doubling; go build, go vet and go test ./... pass.
